han-dynasty-census.description: An interior of a rustic earthen-walled room. A man in a dark robe and black cap sits at a low wooden table writing with a brush on bamboo slips, with bundles of bound slips and an inkstone beside him. At the open door on the right, a older man, a woman holding a toddler, and a small child stand looking in, with a tiled roof visible outside. Pottery jars and hanging dried herbs fill the background. Oil-painting style, edge to edge.

rosetta-stone-tax-decree.description: A shaven-headed man in a white linen robe kneels on a stone floor, striking a chisel with a wooden mallet into a tall dark slab. Torches burn on the walls of a stone temple corridor with carved hieroglyph-like columns. The slab shows fine, indistinct engraved texture, with no legible writing.

quirinius-census-judea.description: Painted scene in a stone-arched street. A bearded man in a striped-hem wrap gestures with open palms at a folding table, where a seated man in a dark tunic and red cloak writes on a wax tablet. A helmeted soldier with a spear stands behind the table, and a queue of townspeople with bundles waits on the left. No visible text and no frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

danegeld-first-paid.description: Painted scene on a overcast shore beside a beached Viking longship with a carved dragon prow. An older white-haired man in a black embroidered robe gestures at a young man in plain tunic who pours silver coins from a sack onto a hanging balance scale. The scale is held by a bearded man in a fur-trimmed cloak with a sword at his belt. Coin sacks and iron weights lie in the mud, and armed warriors with spears and round shields stand behind. No visible text or frame.

saladin-tithe-levied.description: A stone church interior with rounded arches and pillars, lit by candles. A bald priest in a cream cloak and dark robe stands at a wooden iron-bound chest. A bearded knight in chain mail with a cross on his surcoat and another mailed man stand nearby. Townsfolk in medieval peasant dress crowd around, and several are dropping coins into the chest.

ship-money-levied.description: Two men stand before a stone manor doorway in open countryside. The man on the left, in a wide-brimmed hat and long brown leather coat, holds out both open palms. The man on the right, in a dark doublet with a white collar, scowls and presses a hand to his chest. Behind them, a large three-masted galleon with a full set of sails floats in a stormy grey sky above a small stone house and green fields. The painting is an oil-style scene with no visible text, frame or border.

window-tax-england.description: A man in a dark apron and rolled sleeves stands on a wooden ladder against a red brick townhouse, troweling mortar into a window opening. He holds a board of bricks in one hand and a trowel in the other. Below him a wooden bucket sits on a plank beside a lower window. On the street a man in a tricorn hat and long coat holds a paper and points up at the ladder, with onlookers and a cobbled lane behind. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border visible.

peter-great-beard-tax.description: A dark, candlelit vaulted hall. A man with long dark hair, seen from behind in a black long coat with brass buttons and white cuffs, cuts with large shears at the long beard of an older man in a brocade robe trimmed with brown fur, who looks alarmed with wide eyes. Several bearded men in tall fur hats and dark robes stand back in the shadows, some holding candles. No text, no frame, no visible wounds.

corn-laws-enacted.description: A gaunt woman in a ragged shawl and bonnet holds a small loaf of bread and stands with a young girl in tattered clothes beside an iron gate with a padlocked chain. Behind the bars, grain sacks are stacked in a dim warehouse. Masted sailing ships sit in the harbour at night, with lamps and cobblestones, and there is no visible text.

peel-revives-income-tax.description: An older man with grey hair, in a dark frock coat and cravat, sits at a wooden desk in a dimly lit room. He holds a small brass balance scale with gold coins on one pan, with more coins scattered on the desk. A lit candle, a stack of old leather-bound books, an open ornate box, inkwells and a quill sit beside him. The painting is dark, warm and oil-like, filling the whole image with no visible frame or text.

us-first-federal-income-tax.description: A painted interior of a wooden office with a seated older man in a dark suit and bow tie at a desk, sorting coins beside an open ledger and inkwell. A bearded man in a dark coat and black hat leans over the desk placing coins, and a line of men in hats and coats waits at the left edge. Through a multi-pane window behind them, tents and blue-uniformed soldiers are visible on a camp ground. The clothing and setting suggest the 1860s. No readable text or frame is visible.

peoples-budget-lloyd-george.description: An open red leather case on a table, filled with gold and silver coins, with a few spilling out. Behind it, an old woman in a ragged dark shawl and an old man in a flat cap lean in, one reaching toward the coins. Blank papers and a closed leather ledger lie on the table. Through a window at right, a grey dreadnought-style battleship with several gun turrets and tall masts sails on rough sea under smoky sky. Dark, painterly oil style, no visible text.

pay-as-you-go-withholding.description: A man in denim overalls, seen from the side, holds a brown envelope at a wire-mesh teller window in an industrial interior with pipes and steel beams. Behind the window a hand reaches into a metal tray holding coins and some banknotes. Other workers in caps stand in the blurred background under warm lamp light. No visible text, border or signature.

france-introduces-vat.description: A painting of several hands passing a round crusty loaf of bread along a chain. A rough hand on the left holds a bundle of wheat stalks and reaches toward the loaf, while a floury hand in a white apron holds the loaf. A hand at the lower left drops a coin toward a dented tin can on a wooden table, next to a burlap sack of flour. A gloved hand at the lower right holds a coin over a wicker basket. The dark background shows a shop interior with a few blurred figures. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

california-proposition-13.description: A galvanized steel mailbox on a wooden post at dusk, its open flap stuffed with envelopes, with a heavy chain wrapped around it and a padlock hanging from the chain. Behind it sits a single-storey stucco house with a dark shingled roof and a tall palm tree, under a deep blue sky with an orange glow on the horizon. A neighbouring house and fence are partly visible at the left edge. No people, no visible text.
